title: RabbitMQ (AMQP 0-9-1) connector instance config (loams.flow/v1)
description: One RabbitMQ instance's settings (CN2 Task 18, loams_connector_brokers::amqp091): the broker URL, credentials by secret name, the queues a source consumes (one split each) and where a sink publishes. Deliveries are acknowledged only after the Fabric acknowledges them; the sink waits for publisher confirms.

password.description: The password. A secret name, resolved through the namespace's secret store (D189); the value is never stored here.

tls.description: TLS settings: a CA bundle to trust instead of the webpki roots, and a client certificate for mTLS.

cert_pem.description: PEM client certificate chain for mTLS (not a secret).

key_pem.description: The client's PEM private key, for mTLS. A secret name, resolved through the namespace's secret store (D189); the value is never stored here.

queues.description: Queues to consume; one split per queue.

prefetch.description: basic.qos prefetch; by default the pipeline's in-flight budget.

max_batch.description: Messages per batch at most (the pipeline's budget may be smaller).

poll_wait_ms.description: How long one read waits for the first message before reporting nothing.

exchange.description: The exchange; "" is the default exchange, which routes by queue name.

routing_key.description: A fixed routing key; without it, the event's subject.

mandatory.description: Ask the broker to return an unroutable message; it is then poison.

confirm_timeout_ms.description: How long a batch waits for its publisher confirms.

pipeline.description: The SDK's per-instance pipeline overrides (`PipelineConfig::with_overrides`): max_batch_rows, max_batch_bytes, linger_ms, max_in_flight_batches, memory_budget_bytes, checkpoint_interval_ms and retry. The broker-side window (prefetch, credit, Receive Maximum, max_ack_pending, receiver queue) is derived from them unless set.
